terms.title: Term 1
terms.theme: Grade 1 - Foundations of Self, Shapes, and Family (Term 1)

g1_math.competency: Identify simple 2-dimensional shapes (triangle, rectangle, square) of different size and in different orientation. Compare and distinguish 2-dimensional shapes according to features such as sides and corners. Compose and decompose triangles, squares, and rectangles.
g1_math.title: 2-Dimensional Shapes and Features

g1_makabansa.competency: Nailalarawan na ang bawat tao ay may iba't ibang katangiang pisikal (hugis ng mukha, kulay ng balat, tangkad, uri ng buhok).
g1_makabansa.title: Ang Bawat Tao ay Natatangi: Katangiang Pisikal

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang tiwala sa sarili sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng mga batayang impormasyon sa mga angkop na sitwasyon (pangalan, edad, kasarian, magulang, tirahan, petsa ng kapanganakan, palayaw, hilig).
g1_gmrc.title: Tiwala sa Sarili (Self-Confidence)

g1_language.competency: Talk about one's personal experiences: Oneself. Use simple and appropriate personal greetings and respond to teacher's instructions.
g1_language.title: Talking About Oneself and Classroom Greetings

g1_reading.competency: Chant rhymes and poems. Identify rhyming words in nursery rhymes, poems, and chants. Say two or three words that rhyme.
g1_reading.title: Rhymes, Poems, and Word Chants (Oracy for Literacy)

g1_math.competency: Count up to 100 (includes counting up or down from a given number and identifying a number that is 1 more or 1 less than a given number).
g1_math.title: Counting Up to 100

g1_makabansa.competency: Nailalarawan na ang bawat tao ay may iba't ibang pangunahing pangangailangan (pagkain, malinis na tubig, kasuotan, ligtas na tirahan).
g1_makabansa.title: Ang Bawat Tao ay Natatangi: Pangangailangan

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipapakita ang pagiging totoo sa pamamagitan ng mabuting pakikipag-ugnayan sa kapwa. Naiisa-isa ang mga wastong paraan sa pakikipagkaibigan.
g1_gmrc.title: Pagiging Totoo: Mabuting Pakikipag-ugnayan

g1_language.competency: Participate in classroom interactions using verbal and non-verbal responses. Make requests, offer information, and communicate basic needs.
g1_language.title: Participating in Classroom Discussions and Requests

g1_reading.competency: Segment a two to three syllable word into its syllabic parts. Identify initial sounds (vowels, consonants, and semi-vowels).
g1_reading.title: Syllable Segmentation and Initial Sounds

g1_math.competency: Read and write numerals up to 100 in symbols and words.
g1_math.title: Reading and Writing Numerals Up to 100

g1_makabansa.competency: Nailalarawan na ang bawat tao ay may iba't ibang interes, paboritong gawain, at hilig na nagpapakilala sa kaniyang sarili.
g1_makabansa.title: Ang Bawat Tao ay Natatangi: Interes at Hilig

g1_gmrc.competency: Naiuugnay na ang pagkakaibigan ay pagtanggap sa pagkakapareho at pagkakaiba ng mga tao gamit ang magagalang na pananalita at wastong pagtawag sa pangalan.
g1_gmrc.title: Pagiging Totoo: Magalang na Pakikipagkaibigan

g1_language.competency: Use words to represent ideas: words that represent people, animals, and objects, and locations (naming words) related to oneself.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Naming Words: People, Animals, and Objects

g1_reading.competency: Produce the sound of the letters of L1. Identify the letters in L1. Isolate beginning and ending sounds in simple words.
g1_reading.title: Letter Sounds of L1 (Sounds to Words)

g1_math.competency: Recognize and represent numbers up to 100 using a variety of concrete and pictorial models (e.g., number line, block or bar models, and numerals).
g1_math.title: Representing Numbers Up to 100 (Models)

g1_makabansa.competency: Nailalarawan na ang bawat tao ay may iba't ibang kakayahan at talento (pagguhit, pag-awit, pagsayaw, pagtakbo, pagtulong).
g1_makabansa.title: Ang Bawat Tao ay Natatangi: Kakayahan at Talento

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging matiyaga sa pamamagitan ng palagiang pagtatabi ng mga naipong pera sa alkansiya o mga gamit sa lagayan.
g1_gmrc.title: Matiyaga: Pagtatabi at Pag-iimpok

g1_language.competency: Use words to represent ideas and events: action words representing activities and personal situations.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Action Words: Daily Activities and Situations

g1_reading.competency: Substitute individual sounds in simple words to make new words. Sound out words accurately using phonemic knowledge.
g1_reading.title: Sound Substitution and Word Sounding Out

g1_math.competency: Represent numbers up to 100 using tens frames, bundle sticks, and bar models to visualize quantities.
g1_math.title: Number Representation and Place Visualization

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipakikita ang paggalang at pagtanggap sa pagkakaiba-iba ng katangiang pisikal, pangangailangan, interes, at kakayahan ng sarili at kapwa.
g1_makabansa.title: Paghahambing at Paggalang sa Pagkakaiba-iba

g1_gmrc.competency: Naisasaalang-alang at nailalapat ang sariling paraan ng pag-iimpok at pagtitipid na makatutulong upang matugunan ang sariling pangangailangan.
g1_gmrc.title: Matiyaga: Pagtitipid para sa Pangangailangan

g1_language.competency: Use words that represent qualities or attributes (describing words) to describe familiar objects and personal experiences.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Describing Words: Qualities, Colors, and Shapes

g1_reading.competency: Use vocabulary referring to self, family, school, and environment. Identify naming words that label persons, places, things, and emotions.
g1_reading.title: Vocabulary of Self and Naming Words

g1_math.competency: Compare two numbers up to 20. Order numbers up to 20 from smallest to largest, and vice versa.
g1_math.title: Comparing and Ordering Numbers Up to 20

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipagmamalaki ang sariling katangian, kakayahan, at sariling pagkakakilanlan bilang natatanging batang Pilipino.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagbuo at Pagmamalaki sa Sariling Pagkakakilanlan

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging madasalin sa pamamagitan ng wastong kilos at salita sa pananalangin ayon sa sariling pananampalataya.
g1_gmrc.title: Madasalin: Wastong Kilos at Salita

g1_language.competency: Express ideas using a variety of symbols (drawings, emojis, scribbles) and use high-frequency words about oneself.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Expressing Ideas with Symbols and High-Frequency Words

g1_reading.competency: Identify describing words that describe persons, places, things, and emotions. Read high-frequency words accurately for meaning.
g1_reading.title: Describing Words and High-Frequency Sight Words

g1_math.competency: Describe the position of objects using ordinal numbers: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, up to 10th. Compose and decompose numbers up to 10 using concrete materials (e.g., 5 is 5 and 0; 4 and 1; 3 and 2; 2 and 3; 1 and 4; 0 and 5).
g1_math.title: Ordinal Numbers and Number Decomposition

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang mga karapatan ng bawat bata (karapatang maisilang, magkaroon ng pangalan, mag-aral, maging malusog, at magkaroon ng pamilya).
g1_makabansa.title: Karapatan ng Bawat Bata

g1_gmrc.competency: Natutuklasan na ang pananalangin ay nakatutulong sa pagpapabuti ng sariling ugali, disiplina, at kapayapaan ng kalooban.
g1_gmrc.title: Madasalin: Pagpapabuti ng Ugali sa Pananalangin

g1_language.competency: Use language to express connections between ideas: express compare and contrast, cause and effect, and use time words (first, next, then).
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Connecting Ideas: Compare, Contrast, and Time Words

g1_reading.competency: Read content-specific words (Math, Makabansa, and GMRC) accurately for meaning. Write letters and words legibly and correctly.
g1_reading.title: Content-Specific Words and Legible Writing

g1_math.competency: Illustrate addition of numbers with sums up to 20 using concrete and pictorial models ('counting up,' and 'putting together'). Apply addition properties: zero property and commutative property.
g1_math.title: Addition of Numbers with Sums Up to 20

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang mga tungkulin kaakibat ng mga karapatan (pag-aaral nang mabuti, paggalang sa kapwa, pagiging masunurin, at pangangalaga sa sarili).
g1_makabansa.title: Tungkulin ng Bawat Bata

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging mapagpasalamat sa pamamagitan ng pag-iingat ng mga yamang mula sa kapaligiran (halaman, tubig, hangin).
g1_gmrc.title: Mapagpasalamat: Pag-iingat sa Yamang Kapaligiran

g1_language.competency: Notice features (sounds, intonation) of first language (L1). Recognize how intonation and body language change meaning (statements vs questions vs commands).
g1_language.title: Appreciating Language: Intonation, Sounds, and Cues

g1_reading.competency: Recognize environmental print (symbols). Recognize parts of a book (cover page, title page). Recognize proper eye movement skills: left to right, top to bottom, return sweep.
g1_reading.title: Book and Print Knowledge: Environmental Print & Eye Movement

g1_math.competency: Solve problems (given orally or in pictures) involving addition with sums up to 20. Measure the length of an object and the distance between two objects using non-standard units.
g1_math.title: Addition Word Problems and Non-Standard Length

g1_makabansa.competency: Napahahalagahan ang indibidwalidad ng bawat tao tungo sa maayos at mapayapang pakikitungo sa tahanan at paaralan.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagpapahalaga sa Indibidwalidad ng Bawat Tao

g1_gmrc.competency: Naiuugnay at naipahahayag ang pagpapasalamat sa mga biyayang tinatamasa mula sa kapaligiran at pamayanan.
g1_gmrc.title: Mapagpasalamat: Pagpapahayag ng Pasasalamat

g1_language.competency: Recognize how language reflects cultural practices and norms: share language spoken at home, words, phrases, and respectful terms of address.
g1_language.title: Language and Culture: Words, Phrases, and Greetings

g1_reading.competency: Comprehend stories: note important details (character, setting, events), sequence events, infer character's feelings and traits, and predict endings.
g1_reading.title: Comprehending Stories: Details and Sequencing

g1_math.competency: Compare lengths and distances using non-standard units (paper clips, hand spans, foot steps). Solve problems involving lengths and distances using non-standard units.
g1_math.title: Comparing Lengths and Distances with Non-Standard Units

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipakikita sa araw-araw na pakikipagkapwa ang pagtanggap at paggalang sa indibidwalidad ng bawat tao.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagsasabuhay ng Pagpapahalaga sa Kapwa Bata

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging magalang sa pamamagitan ng angkop na kilos na nagbibigay-halaga sa mga karapatang tinatamasa bilang bata (pangalan, edukasyon, pagkain, pamilya).
g1_gmrc.title: Magalang: Karapatan ng Bata (Rights of a Child)

g1_language.competency: View and listen to a range of texts for enjoyment. Identify purposes for listening, express personal preferences, and give reasons for choices.
g1_language.title: Interacting with Spoken Texts and Enjoyment

g1_reading.competency: Comprehend informational text: note significant details, identify problem and solution. Use own words in retelling myths, legends, and fables.
g1_reading.title: Comprehending Informational Texts and Retelling

g1_math.competency: Consolidate knowledge and demonstrate mastery of 2-D shapes, whole numbers to 100, ordinal numbers up to 10th, addition facts up to 20, and non-standard measurement.
g1_math.title: Term 1 Mathematics Consolidation & Mastery

g1_makabansa.competency: Paglalagom ng mga kasanayan sa indibidwalidad, katangian, karapatan, tungkulin, at pagpapahalaga sa kapwa.
g1_makabansa.title: Unang Termino Makabansa Konsolidasyon

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang kalinisan sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa mga alituntunin sa paglilinis ng katawan (paghuhugas ng kamay, paliligo, pagsisipilyo, malinis na damit).
g1_gmrc.title: Kalinisan sa Katawan (Cleanliness) & Unang Termino Pagtatasa

g1_language.competency: Record and report ideas using learned vocabulary: note main points, sequence up to 3 key events, and retell information from fables and short stories.
g1_language.title: Creating Texts: Retelling and Sequencing Events

g1_reading.competency: Demonstrate phonological awareness, letter-sound mastery in L1, word decoding, book awareness, and story comprehension about oneself.
g1_reading.title: Term 1 Reading and Literacy Consolidation

terms.title: Term 2
terms.theme: Grade 1 - Operations, Environment, Values, and Community (Term 2)

g1_math.competency: Order numbers up to 100 from smallest to largest, and vice versa.
g1_math.title: Ordering Numbers Up to 100

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang konsepto ng pamilya batay sa bumubuo nito tulad ng two-parent family (ama, ina, at mga anak).
g1_makabansa.title: Konsepto ng Pamilya: Two-Parent Family

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging magalang sa pamamagitan ng wastong pagtugon sa mensahe ng kapwa at pakikinig nang may paggalang.
g1_gmrc.title: Magalang: Wastong Pagtugon sa Mensahe ng Kapwa

g1_language.competency: Talk about one's personal experiences: Family. Share thoughts, preferences, and feelings with peers and teachers.
g1_language.title: Talking About Family Experiences and Routines

g1_reading.competency: Produce sounds of letters of L1. Identify letters in L1. Isolate beginning and ending sounds in family-themed words.
g1_reading.title: Phonics Mastery: Sounds and Letters of L1

g1_math.competency: Counts by 2s, 5s and 10s up to 100. Determine the place value of a digit in a 2-digit number, the value of a digit, and the digit given its place value.
g1_math.title: Skip Counting and Place Value of 2-Digit Numbers

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang konsepto ng pamilya batay sa bumubuo nito tulad ng solo parent family nang may paggalang at pagmamalaki.
g1_makabansa.title: Konsepto ng Pamilya: Solo Parent Family

g1_gmrc.competency: Nailalapat ang mga paraan ng wastong pakikipag-ugnayan sa kapwa upang magkaroon ng tamang pag-unawa at pakikipagkaibigan.
g1_gmrc.title: Magalang: Wastong Pakikipag-ugnayan sa Kapwa

g1_language.competency: Interact purposely in family-themed discussions: take turns in conversation, clarify information, and seek help politely.
g1_language.title: Conversations About Family and Home Life

g1_reading.competency: Substitute individual sounds in simple words to make new words. Sound out words accurately with speed and automaticity.
g1_reading.title: Sound Substitution and Decoding Accuracy

g1_math.competency: Determine place value and value of digits in numbers up to 100; identify tens and ones in real-life counting.
g1_math.title: Place Value Application and Digit Values

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang konsepto ng pamilya batay sa bumubuo nito tulad ng extended family (lolo, lola, tiyo, tiya, pinsan, tagapangalaga).
g1_makabansa.title: Konsepto ng Pamilya: Extended Family at Iba Pa

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging responsable sa pamamagitan ng pakikiisa sa mga munting gawain sa pamayanan ayon sa sariling kakayahan.
g1_gmrc.title: Responsable: Munting Gawain sa Pamayanan

g1_language.competency: Use naming words representing family members (father, mother, brother, sister, grandparents) and household places and objects.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Naming Words for Family Members and Home

g1_reading.competency: Use vocabulary referring to family, home routines, and environment. Identify words with different functions (naming and describing words).
g1_reading.title: Family Vocabulary and Word Functions

g1_math.competency: Decompose any 2-digit number into tens and ones using concrete materials, drawings, and expanded notations.
g1_math.title: Decomposing 2-Digit Numbers into Tens and Ones

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang papel at tungkulin ng mga magulang at tagapangalaga sa paghubog at pag-aaruga sa pamilya.
g1_makabansa.title: Papel at Tungkulin ng mga Magulang at Tagapangalaga

g1_gmrc.competency: Naisasaalang-alang ang sarili bilang kasapi ng pamayanan na may maibabahagi para sa ikabubuti nito at naisasakilos ang mga tungkulin.
g1_gmrc.title: Responsable: Pagsasakilos ng Tungkulin

g1_language.competency: Use action words representing family cooperation, household chores, and daily home activities.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Action Words for Family Chores and Activities

g1_reading.competency: Read high-frequency sight words automatically for meaning. Read content-specific words (Math, Makabansa, GMRC). Write words legibly.
g1_reading.title: Sight Words and Content Vocabulary (Family Theme)

g1_math.competency: Add numbers by expressing addends as tens and ones (expanded form).
g1_math.title: Addition Using Expanded Form (Tens and Ones)

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang papel at tungkulin ng mga kasapi ng pamilya, partikular ang mga anak (kuya, ate, bunso) sa tahanan.
g1_makabansa.title: Papel at Tungkulin ng mga Anak sa Tahanan

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging matulungin sa mga gawain ng pamilya sa tahanan (pagdidilig, pagliligpit ng gamit at higaan, pagtutupi ng damit).
g1_gmrc.title: Matulungin: Pagtulong sa mga Gawain ng Pamilya

g1_language.competency: Use describing words that represent attributes of family members and feelings within the home.
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Describing Words for Family Attributes and Feelings

g1_reading.competency: Recognize environmental print and symbols. Recognize book parts. Practice smooth eye movement: left-to-right, top-to-bottom, return sweep across sentences.
g1_reading.title: Print Awareness and Tracking Across Sentences

g1_math.competency: Add numbers with sums up to 100 without regrouping, using a variety of concrete and pictorial models for: a. 2-digit and 1-digit numbers, b. 2-digit and 2-digit numbers.
g1_math.title: Addition Up to 100 Without Regrouping

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag kung paano nagtutulungan ang mga kasapi ng pamilya upang mapagaan ang mga pang-araw-araw na gawain.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagtutulungan sa mga Gawain sa Tahanan

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging matulungin sa nakatatanda (elderly) sa pamamagitan ng ligtas na pag-alalay at pag-aabot ng gamit bilang paggalang.
g1_gmrc.title: Matulungin: Ligtas na Pagtulong sa Nakatatanda

g1_language.competency: Express ideas about family using drawings, emojis, and content-specific vocabulary. Participate in group oral language activities (chants, sabayang bigkas).
g1_language.strand: Language for Developing and Expressing Ideas
g1_language.title: Expressing Family Ideas with Symbols and Vocabulary

g1_reading.competency: Comprehend stories about family: note details of characters and settings, sequence story events, and infer feelings and traits.
g1_reading.title: Comprehending Family Stories: Elements & Sequence

g1_math.competency: Solve problems (given orally or in pictures) involving addition with sums up to 100 without regrouping.
g1_math.title: Problem Solving with 2-Digit Addition

g1_makabansa.competency: Naipaliliwanag ang kahalagahan ng pagtupad sa tungkulin ng bawat kasapi para sa kaayusan at kapayapaan sa tahanan.
g1_makabansa.title: Kahalagahan ng Pagtupad sa Tungkulin sa Pamilya

g1_gmrc.competency: Nakapagsasanay sa pagiging madasalin sa pamamagitan ng pakikilahok sa sama-samang pananalangin ng pamilya sa tahanan.
g1_gmrc.title: Madasalin: Pakikilahok sa Pananalangin ng Pamilya

g1_language.competency: Recognize how language reflects family cultural practices: terms of respect (Po, Opo, Manong, Manang, Kuya, Ate, Lolo, Lola).
g1_language.title: Cultural Terms of Respect in the Family

g1_reading.competency: Predict possible endings in family stories. Relate story events to one's own family experience. Identify cause and effect of events.
g1_reading.title: Predicting Endings and Cause-and-Effect in Stories

g1_math.competency: Collect data in one variable through a simple interview. Present data in a pictograph without a scale. Interpret a pictograph without a scale. Organize data into a table.
g1_math.title: Data and Pictographs Without a Scale

g1_makabansa.competency: Napahahalagahan ang papel at tungkulin ng mga kasapi ng pamilya sa pamamagitan ng pagpapasalamat at pagtulong.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagpapahalaga sa Papel at Tungkulin ng Pamilya

g1_gmrc.competency: Naiuugnay na ang pananalangin ng pamilya ay nakatutulong sa pagpapatibay ng samahan, pagmamahalan, at pagkakaisa.
g1_gmrc.title: Madasalin: Pananalangin Nagpapatibay ng Pamilya

g1_language.competency: Engage with and respond to family stories: identify purposes for viewing/listening, discuss what is entertaining, and express preferences.
g1_language.title: Interacting with Stories About Families

g1_reading.competency: Comprehend informational text about families: note significant details (list and describe). Identify problem and solution.
g1_reading.title: Informational Texts: Details, Problem and Solution

g1_math.competency: Illustrate subtraction involving numbers up to 20 using concrete/pictorial models ('taking away'). Find missing numbers in addition/subtraction sentences and write equivalent expressions.
g1_math.title: Subtraction Up to 20 and Equivalent Expressions

g1_makabansa.competency: Nakagagawa ng likhang-sining (pagguhit ng pamilya, family tree) na nagpapakita ng papel at tungkulin ng mga kasapi ng pamilya.
g1_makabansa.title: Paglikha ng Sining para sa Pamilya (Part 1)

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang kalinisan sa pamamagitan ng pakikibahagi sa paglilinis sa loob at labas ng tahanan (paghihiwalay ng basura, pagwawalis, pagliligpit).
g1_gmrc.title: Kalinisan: Pangangalaga sa Kapaligiran ng Tahanan

g1_language.competency: Record and report family events using learned vocabulary: note main points and sequence up to 3 key events in order.
g1_language.title: Creating Texts: Sequencing 3 Key Family Events

g1_reading.competency: Narrate one's personal experiences about one's family. Use own words in retelling fables and narrative poems.
g1_reading.title: Narrating Family Personal Experiences

g1_math.competency: Solve subtraction problems where numbers are less than 20. Subtract numbers where both numbers are less than 100 without regrouping (2-digit minus 1-digit, 2-digit minus 2-digit, expanded form).
g1_math.title: 2-Digit Subtraction Without Regrouping

g1_makabansa.competency: Napahahalagahan ang papel at tungkulin ng mga kasapi ng pamilya sa pamamagitan ng pagtatanghal at pagbabahagi ng likhang-sining.
g1_makabansa.title: Pagtatanghal ng Likhang-Sining ng Pamilya (Part 2)

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging masunurin sa mabuting gawi ng pamilyang Pilipino at pagsasagawa ng tagubilin para sa pansariling kaligtasan.
g1_gmrc.title: Masunurin at Tiwala sa Sarili sa mga Tagubilin

g1_language.competency: Use own words in retelling fables, legends, and stories about family; infer character feelings and predict endings.
g1_language.title: Retelling Family Fables and Folktales

g1_reading.competency: Express ideas about family in writing and drawing. Respond creatively to texts (myths, legends, fables, narrative poems).
g1_reading.title: Creative Responses and Expressing Ideas on Family

g1_math.competency: Consolidate mastery of place value up to 100, 2-digit addition and subtraction without regrouping, pictographs without scale, and problem solving.
g1_math.title: Term 2 Mathematics Consolidation & Mastery

g1_makabansa.competency: Paglalagom ng mga konsepto ng pamilya, pagganap ng tungkulin, pagtutulungan, at paglikha ng sining.
g1_makabansa.title: Ikalawang Termino Makabansa Konsolidasyon

g1_gmrc.competency: Naipakikita ang pagiging mapagbigay sa pamamagitan ng kusang-loob na pagbabahagi ng anumang mayroon siya sa kapwa.
g1_gmrc.title: Mapagbigay (Generosity) & Ikalawang Termino Pagtatasa

g1_language.competency: Deliver an oral narrative about one's family using full sentences, appropriate intonation, and creative drawings.
g1_language.title: Term 2 Language Showcase: My Family Story

g1_reading.competency: Demonstrate decoding fluency, sight word recognition, family story analysis, and written narrative responses.
g1_reading.title: Term 2 Reading and Literacy Consolidation

terms.title: Term 3
terms.theme: Grade 1 - Measurement, Time, Patriotism, and Literacy Synthesis (Term 3)

g1_math.competency: Determine the next term/s in a repeating pattern using rhythmic properties, visual elements in the arts, numbers, and letters.
g1_math.title: Determining Next Terms in Repeating Patterns

g1_makabansa.competency: Nailalahad ang mga batayang impormasyon tulad ng pangalan, pinagmulan, laki at lawak, kinaroroonan, at kwento ng sariling paaralan.
g1_makabansa.strand: Tayo Bilang Kasapi ng Paaralan at Pamayanan

Participate in guided science activities to explore and describe liquid substances and their properties, such as fluidity and container shape.

Vocabulary and Word Knowledge — Pronouns and Word Relationships Identify and use personal, interrogative, possessive, and demonstrative pronouns. Identify the synonyms and antonyms of words. Read words correctly for meaning based on word patterns.

Paglinang ng Talasalitaan — Salitang Pangkayarian at Pagbasa Natutukoy ang kahulugan ng salitang pangkayarian (pangatnig at pang-angkop). Nababasa nang wasto at naisusulat nang maayos ang mga natutuhang salita. Natutukoy ang salitang-ugat ng mga natutuhang salitang high frequency.

Mapagmalasakit (Compassion) Naipakikita ang pagiging mapagmalasakit sa pamamagitan ng tamang paglalaan ng mga pera o gamit na angkop sa iba't ibang situwasyon. Nakakikilala ng mga paraan ng pagpapatatag ng mga gawi sa pag-iimpok at pagtitipid kasama ang pamilya. Napatutunayan na ito ay magpapaunlad ng sariling kasanayan na mapamahalaan ang mas malaking halaga ng pera o mga gamit sa kinabukasan. Naisasakilos ang mga paraan ng pagpapatatag ng mga gawi sa pag-iimpok at pagtitipid.
Natatalakay ang mahahalagang tao, lugar, at pangyayari na bahagi ng kasaysayan ng lalawigan na kinabibilangan.

subjects.competency: Measurement and Geometry Recognize and draw parallel, intersecting, and perpendicular lines. Identify and draw line segments of equal length using a ruler.
Participate in guided science activities to explore and describe gases around us, their presence, and their importance.

Vocabulary and Word Knowledge / Grammar Awareness — Word Accuracy and Introduction to Sentences Write words legibly and correctly based on word patterns. Identify roots of high-frequency words. Identify sentences and non-sentences. Use simple sentences to express ideas, with proper intonation, and sequence words to form telling (declarative) sentences.

Paglinang ng Talasalitaan / Gramatika — Bahaging Pangungusap Nakikilala ang kahulugan ng mga salita (magkasingkahulugan at magkasalungat). Natutukoy ang mga bahagi ng payak na pangungusap (simuno at panaguri), ang sugnay na nakapag-iisa sa tambalang pangungusap, at ang mga pananda sa teksto.

Responsable (Responsible) — Fokus: Batayang Kaalaman Naipakikita ang pagiging responsable sa pamamagitan ng wastong pagtupad sa kaniyang mga gampanin batay sa mga tagubilin ng magulang at nakatatanda. Natutukoy ang mga gawain ng isang bata sa tahanan at paaralan.
Natatalakay ang mahahalagang tao, lugar, at pangyayari na bahagi ng kasaysayan ng rehiyon na kinabibilangan.

Science Processes Describe different science process skills used in performing simple science activities, such as observing, predicting, and measuring using units such as millimeter, centimeter, and meter.

Grammar Awareness — Sentence Sequencing and Parts Sequence words to form asking (interrogative), commanding/requesting (imperative), and exclamatory sentences. Identify the parts of telling and asking sentences.

Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto — Mabilis na Pagbasa at Elemento ng Kuwento Nababasa nang may tatas (may damdamin at tamang bilis) ang mga pangungusap. Naibibigay ang elemento ng tekstong naratibo. Natutukoy ang damdamin ng tauhan. Nakikilala ang katangian ng tauhan at tagpuan.

Responsable (Responsible) — Fokus: Pag-unawa at Pagbabahagi Napatutunayan na ang mga sariling gampanin ng bata sa tahanan at paaralan ay nakatutulong upang mahubog ang pagiging responsable sa kanilang gawain at kilos. Nakapagbabahagi ng mga karanasan sa pagtugon sa mga gampanin ng isang bata sa tahanan at paaralan.
Nakabubuo ng talaan ng kasaysayan (timeline) ng kinabibilangang pook batay sa mahahalagang tao, lugar, at pangyayari nito.

subjects.competency: Number and Algebra Read and write numbers up to 10 000 in numerals and in words.
Describe changes in materials based on temperature: melting and freezing.

Grammar Awareness — Sentence Parts and Capitalization Identify the parts of commanding/requesting and exclamatory sentences. Use correct capitalization and punctuation for telling, asking, commanding/requesting, and exclamatory sentences. Identify the two independent clauses in a compound sentence.

Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto — Pagsusuring Pangyayari sa Kuwento Naibibigay ang suliranin at solusyon sa kuwento. Naisasaayos ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng lima hanggang anim na pangyayari. Naibibigay ang sanhi at bunga ng mga pangyayari, at ang posibleng wakas ng kuwento.

Pananalig sa Diyos (Faith in God) Naipakikita ang pananalig sa Diyos sa pamamagitan ng pagsunod sa Kaniyang mga aral. Nakakikilala ng mga sariling pagkilos ng may paggalang sa Diyos. Naipaliliwanag na ito ay tanda ng pagkilala at pagmamahal sa Kaniya at nagdudulot ng pagkakaroon ng mabuting asal. Nailalapat ang mga pagkilos na nagpapakita ng paggalang sa Diyos.
Naipaliliwanag ang mga pagbabagong naganap sa populasyon ng kinabibilangang komunidad.
subjects.strand: Ang Ating Komunidad sa Paglipas ng Panahon

subjects.competency: Number and Algebra Describe the position of objects using ordinal numbers up to 100th.
Describe changes in materials based on temperature: evaporation and condensation.

Grammar Awareness — Compound Sentences and Discourse Markers Identify the joining word (coordinating conjunction) and the doers/actions in the two clauses of a compound sentence. Use correct capitalization and punctuation in compound sentences. Identify discourse markers used in time-order/procedural, descriptive, and explanatory texts.

Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto — Pagbubuod, Konektado sa Kuwento Nakabubuod ng teksto. Naiuugnay ang sariling karanasan sa kuwento. Natutukoy ang nagsasalaysay sa teksto. Naibibigay ang mensahe ng teksto.

Disiplina (Discipline) — Fokus: Batayang Kaalaman Naipakikita ang disiplina sa pamamagitan ng pakikiisa sa mga gawaing pangkapaligiran. Natutukoy ang mga pansariling gawain na nakabubuti sa kapaligiran.
Naipaliliwanag ang mga pagbabagong naganap sa kapaligiran at imprastraktura ng kinabibilangang komunidad.

Participate in guided activities observing physical changes when substances are mixed or dissolved.
Comprehending Texts — Story Comprehension Read grade-level sentences with appropriate speed, accuracy, and expression. Note important elements in a story (characters, setting, and events).

Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto — Detalye at Suliranin sa Tekstong Impormatibo Naibibigay ang limang mahahalagang detalye sa tekstong impormatibo. Natutukoy ang suliranin at solusyon, at ang naglalahad sa teksto. Naibibigay ang mahahalagang impormasyon (paksa, pangunahing idea, sumusuportang detalye).

Disiplina (Discipline) — Fokus: Pag-unawa at Paglalapat Naipaliliwanag na ang mga pansariling gawain na nakabubuti sa kapaligiran ay magdudulot ng ligtas, maayos, at malinis na pamayanan. Naisasakilos ang mga natukoy na mabuting magagawa ng bata sa kapaligiran.
Naipaliliwanag ang mga pagbabagong naganap sa pamumuhay at kabuhayan ng kinabibilangang komunidad.

Identify useful and harmful changes in materials around the home and school.

Comprehending Texts — Predicting, Summarizing, and Informational Texts Sequence at least five events in a story. Identify the problem and solution presented in a story. Infer a character's feelings and traits. Relate story events to one's own experience. Identify cause and effect of events. Predict a possible ending for a story.

Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto — Layunin, Organisasyon, at Konklusyon Naibibigay ang nais ipabatid ng awtor. Natutukoy ang huwaran ng organisasyon ng tekstong impormatibo (pag-iisa-isa-paglalarawan; pagsusunod-sunod). Naibibigay ang kongklusyon at mensahe ng tekstong impormatibo.

Paggalang (Respect) Nakapagsasanay sa pagiging magalang sa pamamagitan ng wastong pakikitungo sa kapwa sa iba't ibang sitwasyon. Naiisa-isa ang mga pansariling karapatan na natatamasa ng isang bata sa pamayanan. Naipaliliwanag na ito ay nagtitiyak sa kaligtasan at matiwasay na pamumuhay ng bawat bata. Naisasakilos ang mga gawain na nagbibigay-halaga sa mga karapatang tinatamasa ng bawat bata.
Nakagagawa ng likhang-sining na nagpapakita ng kasaysayan ng kinabibilangang komunidad.

Explain safety measures when handling hot objects, sharp materials, and chemical substances.

Identify the problem and solution presented in an informational text. Identify time-order/procedural, descriptive, and explanatory text types.

Pagbuo ng Teksto — Pagbati at Simulang Pagsulat Nagagamit ang magagalang na pananalita sa pagbati at ekspresyon sa iba't ibang sitwasyon. Nagagamit ang mga salitang high frequency at may tiyak na tuong pangnilalaman sa pagbuo ng maikling talata. Nakabubuo ng maikling talatang naglalarawan ng karanasan tungkol sa sarili, bansa, at tiyak na paksa.

Pakikiisa (Cooperation) — Fokus: Batayang Kaalaman Naipakikita ang pakikiisa sa pamamagitan ng pagtupad sa mga gawain sa loob ng tahanan na ayon sa kaniyang kakayahan. Natutukoy ang mga sariling paraan ng pakikilahok sa mga gawain sa loob ng tahanan.
Nakagagawa ng likhang-sining na nagpapakita ng pagbabagong naganap sa kinabibilangang komunidad.

subjects.competency: Number and Algebra Order numbers up to 10 000 from smallest to largest, and vice versa.

Retell myths, legends, fables, and narrative poems using own words. Express ideas about one's own experiences and content-specific topics. Use basic sight words, high-frequency words, and content-specific words in composing.

Pagbuo ng Teksto — Reaksiyon, Buod, at Organisasyon ng Idea Nakabubuo ng maikling talata gamit ang payak at tambalang pangungusap sa pagpapahayag ng reaksiyon sa mga pangyayari sa teksto, sa paksa, pangunahing idea, at sumusuportang detalye. Nakabubuod ng tekstong naratibo. Nakapagpapahayag ng idea batay sa huwaran ng organisasyon ng tekstong impormatibo.

Pakikiisa (Cooperation) — Fokus: Pag-unawa at Paglalapat Naipaliliwanag na ang sariling paraan ng pakikilahok sa mga gawain ng pamilya ay nakatutulong sa pagkakabuklod-buklod at pagpapatatag ng ugnayan ng bawat kasapi ng pamilya. Nailalapat ang mga sariling paraan ng pakikiisa sa mga gawain sa loob ng tahanan.
Napahahalagahan ang kasaysayan at pagbabagong nagaganap sa kinabibilangang komunidad.

subjects.competency: Word Patterns and Regional Vocabulary • Identify Grade 3 level-appropriate sight words. (Phonics and Word Study) • Read VCV words accurately and automatically. (Phonics and Word Study) • Read VCCV words accurately and automatically. (Phonics and Word Study) • Identify high-frequency words accurately. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Use vocabulary referring to regional themes. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge)

Naipaliliwanag ang ugnayan ng kapaligiran at kultura.

Measurement and Geometry: • Measure mass in grams (g), kilograms (kg) and/or milligrams (mg), using appropriate measuring tools. • Estimate mass of an object using grams, kilograms, and/or milligrams. • Compare masses of objects including the use of a balance scale.

Guided Science Activities Using Process Skills and Living and Non-Living Things (Week 1 to 2): • Observe and describe the difference between living and non-living things and give examples of each that can be found in the local environment. • Describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce.

Content Words, Verbs, Adjectives, and Pronouns • Use vocabulary referring to content-specific topics. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Use content-specific words for Mathematics (basic symbols and terminologies). (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Use content-specific words for Science (basic terminologies). (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify words that label actions (verbs). (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify words that describe persons, places, things, animals, events, ideas, and emotions (adjectives). (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify and use personal pronouns. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify and use demonstrative pronouns. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge)

Kahulugan ng Salita • Natutukoy ang kahulugan ng mga salitang tumutukoy sa ngalan ng tao, bagay, hayop, lugar, at pangyayari (dinaglat). (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan) • Natutukoy ang kahulugan ng salitang pangkayarian (pangatnig, pang-angkop, at pang-ukol). (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan) • Nababasa nang wasto ang mga natutuhang salita. (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan)

Maingat na Paghuhusga (Prudence): Naipakikita ang maingat na paghuhusga sa mga impormasyon tungkol sa barangay na kinabibilangan. • Nakakikilala ng mga impormasyon tungkol sa barangay na kinabibilangan. • Napatutunayan na ang mga impormasyon sa barangay na kinabibilangan ay mahalagang gampanin sa pagpapanatili ng kaayusan, kaligtasan at katahimikan ng mamamayan. • Nakapagbabahagi ng mga impormasyon tungkol sa barangay na kinabibilangan.
Naipaliliwanag kung paano naiimpluwensyahan ng kultura ang pang-araw-araw na pamumuhay sa komunidad.

Measurement and Geometry: • Measure capacity in liters (L) and/or milliliters (mL), using appropriate measuring tools. • Estimate capacity using liters and/or milliliters. • Compare capacities of two containers.

Guided Science Activities Using Process Skills and Living and Non-Living Things: (Continuation — see Week 1.) Same competencies apply; teachers may sequence across Weeks 1 to 2 based on learners' needs.

Word Meaning and Accuracy • Identify the synonyms and antonyms of words. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Read words correctly for meaning based on word patterns. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Write words legibly and correctly based on word patterns. (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify roots of high-frequency words (nouns, verbs, and adjectives). (Vocabulary and Word Knowledge) • Identify sentences and non-sentences. (Grammar Awareness)

Pagsulat at Ugat ng Salita • Naisusulat nang maayos at wasto ang mga natutuhang salita. (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan) • Natutukoy ang salitang-ugat ng mga natutuhang salitang high frequency o madalas gamitin. (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan) • Nakikilala ang kahulugan ng mga salita (magkasingkahulugan at magkasalungat). (Paglinang ng Talasalitaan)

Pagiging Totoo (Sincerity): Fokus: Batayang Kaalaman Naipakikita ang pagiging totoo sa pamamagitan ng wastong pakikipag-ugnayan sa bawat kasapi ng pamilya. • Nailalarawan ang pakikipag-ugnayan sa bawat kasapi ng pamilya.
Natatalakay ang kahulugan ng pagkakakilanlan ng kinabibilangang komunidad.

Number and Algebra: • Read and write money in words and using: (a) Philippine currency symbols (₱ and PhP) up to ₱10 000; (b) the centavo sign. • Add numbers with sums up to 10 000, with and without regrouping.

Characteristics of Living Things (Week 3 to 4): • Observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food. • Observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil.

Building and Sequencing Sentences • Use simple sentences to express ideas about regional themes and content-specific topics. (Grammar Awareness) • Use simple sentences with proper intonation (pitch, juncture, and rhythm). (Grammar Awareness) • Sequence words to form telling (declarative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Sequence words to form asking (interrogative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Sequence words to form commanding and requesting (imperative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Sequence words to form exclamatory sentences. (Grammar Awareness)

Sugnay at Pagbasa nang May Tatas • Natutukoy ang sugnay na nakapag-iisa sa tambalang pangungusap. (Gramatika) • Natutukoy ang mga pananda sa teksto (hudyat ng pag-iisa-isa-paglalarawan; hudyat ng pagsusunod-sunod). (Gramatika) • Nababasa nang may tatas (may damdamin at tamang bilis) ang mga pangungusap. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto)

Pagiging Totoo (Sincerity): Fokus: Pangangatuwiran at Paglalapat Naipakikita ang pagiging totoo sa pamamagitan ng wastong pakikipag-ugnayan sa bawat kasapi ng pamilya. • Napangangatuwiranan na ang wastong pakikipag-ugnayan sa bawat kasapi ng pamilya ay daan upang malinang ang pagmamahalan at pagkakaunawaan. • Nailalapat ang mga sariling paraan ng wastong pakikipag-ugnayan sa bawat kasapi ng pamilya.
Natatalakay ang kahalagahan ng himno bilang sagisag ng kinabibilangang komunidad.
Number and Algebra: • Estimate the sum of addends with up to 4 digits. (Week 4 to 5): • Solve problems involving addition of numbers with sums up to 10 000, including problems involving money.
Characteristics of Living Things: (Continuation — see Week 3.) Same competencies apply; teachers may sequence across Weeks 3 to 4 based on learners' needs.

Sentence Parts and Capitalization • Identify the parts of telling (declarative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the parts of asking (interrogative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the parts of commanding and requesting (imperative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the parts of exclamatory sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Use correct capitalization and punctuation for telling (declarative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Use correct capitalization and punctuation for asking (interrogative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness)

Elemento at Damdamin sa Kuwento • Naibibigay ang elemento ng teksto. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Natutukoy ang damdamin ng tauhan sa mga pangyayari. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Nakikilala ang katangian ng tauhan at tagpuan. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Naibibigay ang suliranin at solusyon sa kuwento. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto)

Pagkukusa (Initiative): Nakapagsasanay ng pagkukusa sa pamamagitan ng wastong pagtugon sa mga itinakdang gawain at iskedyul. • Natutukoy ang mga gawain na nagpapakita ng pagtupad sa mga gampanan at mga inaasahang kilos sa tahanan at paaralan. • Nasusuri na ang pagtupad sa mga gampanin at mga inaasahang kilos sa tahanan at paaralan ay lilinang ng mga gawi na makatutulong sa pagpapaunlad ng kaniyang mga kasanayan at ugnayan sa kapwa. • Nailalapat ang mga inaasahang kilos nang may pagkukusa sa tahanan at paaralan.
Natatalakay ang kahalagahan ng coat of arms at bayaning lokal bilang sagisag ng kinabibilangang komunidad.

Number and Algebra: (Continuation — see Week 4.) Solve problems involving addition of numbers with sums up to 10 000, including problems involving money. (Week 5 to 6): • Subtract numbers, where both numbers are less than 10 000, with and without regrouping.

Basic Needs of Living Things (Week 5 to 7): • Identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter. • Observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another and on the environment to meet their basic needs. • Recognize that there is a need to protect and conserve the environment for living things to survive.

Capitalization and Compound Sentences • Use correct capitalization and punctuation for commanding and requesting (imperative) sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Use correct capitalization and punctuation for exclamatory sentences. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the two independent clauses in a compound sentence. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the joining word (coordinating conjunction) in a compound sentence. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify the doers and the actions in the two clauses of a compound sentence. (Grammar Awareness) • Use correct capitalization and punctuation in compound sentences. (Grammar Awareness)

Pagsusuring Pangyayari sa Kuwento • Naisasaayos ang pagkakasunod-sunod ng anim na pangyayari. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Naibibigay ang sanhi at bunga ng mga pangyayari. Naiuugnay ang sining ng komunidad sa sariling pagkakakilanlan.

Number and Algebra: (Continuation — see Week 5.) Subtract numbers, where both numbers are less than 10 000, with and without regrouping. (Week 6 to 7): • Estimate the difference of two numbers of up to 4 digits. • Perform addition and subtraction of 3 to 4 numbers of up to 2 digits, observing correct order of operations.
Basic Needs of Living Things: (Continuation — see Week 5.) Same competencies apply; teachers may sequence across Weeks 5 to 7 based on learners' needs.

Discourse Markers and Story Elements • Identify discourse markers used in time-order and procedural texts. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify discourse markers used in descriptive texts. (Grammar Awareness) • Identify discourse markers used in explanatory texts. (Grammar Awareness) • Read grade-level sentences with appropriate speed, accuracy, and expression. (Comprehending Texts) • Note important elements in a story (characters, setting, and events). (Comprehending Texts) • Sequence at least five events in a story. (Comprehending Texts)

Koneksiyon at Detalyeng Tekstong Impormatibo • Naiuugnay ang sariling karanasan sa kuwento. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Natutukoy ang nagsasalaysay sa teksto. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Naibibigay ang mensahe ng teksto. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto) • Naibibigay ang lima hanggang anim na mahahalagang detalye sa tekstong impormatibo. (Pag-unawa at Pagsusuri ng Teksto)
